name: Zedekiah
overview: Zedekiah, the last king of Judah and grandson of Jehoiakim, was appointed by Nebuchadnezzar but ultimately rebelled against Babylonian rule, forming an alliance with Egypt contrary to God's command (1 Chronicles 3:16; Jeremiah 1:3; Jeremiah 27:12). Despite Jeremiah's warnings and denouncements of his disobedience, Zedekiah imprisoned the prophet and faced the consequences of his evil reign, including the destruction of Jerusalem and the temple, and his own captivity and blindness (Jeremiah 21:1; Jeremiah 24:8). Additionally, a false prophet named Zedekiah, distinct from the king, prophesied lies in God's name and was condemned by the Lord (Jeremiah 29:21).
